_about: Townsfolk and flavour NPCs per section. art = a key in art/characters. tile [col,row] pins a spot; without one, tools/sections/build_world.py places them on open walkable ground (clear of exits, doors and each other). Story characters (Vashti, Sola, Keepers) are driven by the quest engine, not listed here.

001.name: Mom
t: Mom: Look at you two! Remember, if your Alienmon get tired, the Recovery Bay heals them for free.
Mom: And call home once in a while, Linker.
pre: Mom: Good morning, sleepyhead! Dr. Vashti called. She's waiting for you at her observatory lab.
Mom: It's the big dome with the telescope, across the plaza. Go on, your partner is waiting!

003.name: Dr. Vashti
t: Dr. Vashti: The Starfall Crater glows purple again. Something down there is stirring.
Dr. Vashti: Bring me news from every world you visit. And take care of your partner.

003.name: Lab aide
pre: Lab aide: Dr. Vashti has been waiting for you! She's by the pod table.
t: Lab aide: Dr. Vashti tracks every seedpod that fell twenty years ago. There are still hundreds unaccounted for.
Lab aide: The big telescope points at the Starfall Crater. It's been glowing purple again.
Bram: Sola's always at the Trading Post. If she says she's waiting for you, she means a battle!
Bram: The drift grass crackles with blue sparks. That's how you know Alienmon are hiding in it!
pre: Kid: You're getting your first Alienmon today? Lucky! Dr. Vashti's lab is the dome with the telescope.
004.name: Bram

t: Mr. Abernathy: Honey rolls, fresh out of the oven! First one's free for anybody with a brand-new partner.
Mr. Abernathy: I've baked for Dustmere since before the Starfall. Never once burned a loaf. ...Well. Once.
004.name: Mr. Abernathy

t: Girl: This is my Pebblet! It's a rock. It's my best friend. Both!
Girl: When it's sleepy it rolls into the shade. When it's happy it rolls into ME.
Girl: DX-4 keeps wandering off toward the bridge. Pebblet follows him. I follow Pebblet.
004.name: Rock-girl

t: Linker: Press START to check your team. A tired Alienmon is a fainted Alienmon waiting to happen.
Woman: The shop dome sells Stasis Pods. You can't catch anything without them!
Woman: Weaken an Alienmon first. A full-health one just pops right back out.
Watchman: West of here is the landing pad. Ships only leave with launch clearance from a Keeper.

004.name: DX-4
t: DX-4: Bzzt! Scout unit DX-4 online.
DX-4: The bridge crosses the canyon to the east trading post. Mind the lava falls!

004.name: Old Dusty
t: Dusty: Name's Dusty. I've lived on this rim since the Starfall.
Dusty: That crater past the falls? The seedpods came down hot as stars twenty years back.

004.name: Kit
t: Kit: I'm keeper of the Shards now. ...Okay, I gave myself that job. But somebody has to!
Kit: Dad gave me his old welding goggles. They're too big. I'm keeping them.

005.name: Nurse
t: Nurse: Welcome to the Recovery Bay! Step up to the counter and I'll heal your team.
Trainer: I come here after every route. Healing is free, so there's no excuse to push your luck.

006.name: Shopkeeper
t: Shopkeeper: Talk to me at the counter for pods and potions!
Shopper: Gels heal, Cure Spray fixes poison and burns. I always carry both.
Hiker: Don't look down. That canyon goes all the way to the old lava falls.
Bridge keeper: This bridge was built by Ferrox steelworkers. Not a single rivet has slipped in forty years.
Snack trader: Battle snacks! Get your battle snacks! Roasted cactus nuts, still crackling!
Trader: Everything here came over the Molten Frontier on a cart. Prices reflect the danger!
008.name: Snack trader

t: Kid: The lemonade stand? That was... an accident. Mostly the lamb's fault.
008.name: Kid with a lamb

t: Miner: The Sunset Tunnel past the cactus gardens is the only way through to the Frontier on foot.
Drifter: Sola trains out back every morning. Tough kid. Even tougher partner.
Linker: Trainers on the trail will battle you the moment they spot you. Walk past them if you're feeling brave.

008.name: Referee
t: Referee: One-on-one! First partner who can't keep going loses! No hitting trainers, no fighting dirty!
Referee: ...And no knocking over my lemonade stand AGAIN.

008.name: Fenna
t: Fenna: Spores, roots, a few mushrooms that hum. I trade them for anything shiny.
Fenna: Sporeholm grows mushrooms bigger than houses. Bigger than Dustmere, nearly!
Hiker: The Rimwalk Trail hugs the canyon edge. Great view, terrible place to trip.
Birdwatcher: I've seen Alienmon with wings riding the thermals over the canyon.
Researcher: Different grass patches hold different Alienmon. Try them all!
Camper: If you're low on health, head back to Dustmere. Pride is not a healing item.
Gardener: These cacti store water for months. Some Alienmon nest right inside them.
Explorer: The Sunset Tunnel is just east. Bring light, it's a maze in there.
Miner: Watch your step. The lanterns down here run on crystal shards.
Old miner: You can feel the heat from here. The Molten Frontier is right above us.
Guard: Welcome to the Molten Frontier. Stick to the trails and stay off anything glowing.
Traveller: The ash trail east leads to Palm Isle and Port Ember. Rest up there.
Guard: You're entering the Molten Frontier.
Helix built their forge fortress at the top of the ridge. Watch yourself up there.
Miner: That tunnel runs all the way under the sea to Sunset Canyon.
The ground's been rumbling since Helix started digging.
Ash walker: The ash makes everything look grey, but the Alienmon out here are anything but dull.
Sporefolk: Even here, spores find a way. The red blooms feed on lava heat.
Nomad: Magma-types love the warm ground. Hydro moves cool them off fast.
Geologist: These vents breathe every few minutes. Count to ten and you'll see.
Bug Catcher Grub: Fire bugs! The hottest bugs! Battle me!

017.name: Nurse Coral
t: Nurse Coral: Welcome to the Palm Isle Recovery Hut! Let me patch your team up.
Nurse Coral: Wait. Is that... R.B. No. 1? That's Wren's badge!
Nurse Coral: I was her apprentice at the Dustmere Recovery Bay the night the stars fell. She taught me everything.
Nurse Coral: You've got her eyes. Come here, let me patch your team up. For Wren.
Islander: Palm Isle is the only green spot for miles. The Recovery Hut here has saved a lot of Linkers.
Fruit picker: Try the fire-coconuts. Crunchy outside, molten inside.
Explorer: The hut here is a Recovery Hut. Rest up before you head into the lava fields.
Weaken a wild Alienmon with a Tether Pulse, shock it with a Stun Spray, then fire the transfer beam!
Pilgrim Sol: The island spirits test every traveler. Let's battle!
Sailor: The Deep Sea Ferry leaves from the long dock. Only cleared Linkers ride, though.
Dock mechanic: Helix boats have been prowling the harbor. Keep your pods close.
Fish seller: Fresh from the ember sea! Well... warm from the ember sea.
Harbor guard: Port Ember's been a safe harbor for a hundred years. We intend to keep it that way.
Linker: Every Keeper you beat gives you a Signal Shard. Eight of them and something big happens. Nobody agrees on what.
Villager: Welcome to Port Ember, the last calm shore before the lava fields.

018.name: Mina
t: Mina: This hood? It's a shark. Obviously. The fish respect it.
Mina: Cast past the end of the boardwalk and wait. Something on Thalassa always bites back.
Deckhand: Mind the gaps between the planks. The sea down there is hot enough to boil soup.
Squid Sailor: The ferry at the end of this dock sails to the Deep Sea Ruins.
Hop aboard whenever you're ready.
Climber: The Ridge Path climbs toward the Forge Gate. Helix guards everywhere up there.
Researcher Kel: Lava-forged Alienmon have incredible stats. Let me show you!
Scout: I saw Helix grunts hauling crates toward the fortress. Something's being built in there.
Wanderer: The paths wind down the ridge to the Forge Gate and the shuttle pad.
Wild Alienmon roam the trails between towns. Keep your team healthy.
Forge worker: The Forge Gate opens toward Ferrox once you've proven yourself.
Gate guard: No clearance, no passage. Those are the rules.
Forge Miner Dax: The gate's mine to guard. Beat me first!
Refugee: Helix took the old forge and turned it into a fortress. We had to leave everything.

023.name: Helix Grunt
t: Helix Grunt: Halt! This forge belongs to the Helix Directive.
Helix Grunt: Run along, kid. Come back when you're a real Linker, and maybe I'll bother beating you.
Helix Grunt: Halt! This forge belongs to the Helix Directive!
Former Helix worker: Helix is finished. I just want to fix things now.

023.name: Grub
t: Grub: Psst. I used to work in that Forge. I know a way in.
Grub: Beat the grunt at the door, then find the control room terminal. The keycard is in there.
Bridge tech: These lava bridges are cooled by pumps. If they stop, run.
Linker: Almost at the shuttle pad. Ships to the far planets launch from there.
Technician: This dish relays every signal in the Frontier.
Lately it keeps catching a pulse from the Starfall crater. Same rhythm, every night.
Pad controller: Shuttles leave when the board says so. The board says 'not yet'.
Helix deserter: I flew shuttles for Helix. Never again. Ask me nothing about the Director.
Strand: Helix shuttles fly from this pad straight to the Starfall Rift.
Whatever they're hauling out there, they don't want anyone to see.
Lantern keeper: The Shadow Tunnel leads to Umbra. The dark in there plays tricks on you.
Mine foreman: The Magma Mines run all the way down to Pyros' crust. Hard hats mandatory.
Ystran echo: ...the mountain's heart burns like Ystra's dying sun...
...the Magma Mines go deeper than anyone has dared...
Gate guard: Welcome to Ferrox. Mind the rails, the ore carts don't stop for anyone.
Porter: Everything that lands here gets weighed, stamped and argued over. That's Ferrox for you.
Traveller: First time on Ferrox? Rustvale is just east. Best scrap stew in the system.
Scrapper: Everything here is built from junk. Even the Relay Tower.
Rail hand: Alloy-types love the rail yard. Bring something that burns.
Kid: Hank's Alienmon are tough as old boilers!
Watchman: Helix suits were sniffing around the crane yard last night. Hank's not happy.
Old welder: Hank Briggs runs the tower at the end of Furnace Ridge. You'll need a Shard's worth of guts to face him.
Linker: Magma moves melt Alloy-types fast. Volt moves just bounce off.

030.name: Kit
t: Kit: Dad says I can fix anything except my own room.
Kit: My {kit} sniffs out loose bolts. It's better at it than me!

031.name: Nurse
t: Nurse: Welcome to the Rustvale Recovery Bay. Step up to the counter!
Miner: I patch up my Alienmon here after every shift. The nurse doesn't even charge for the soot.

032.name: Shopkeeper
t: Shopkeeper: Pods, gels, sprays. Talk to me at the counter.
Customer: Stun Spray is a lifesaver on the Scrap Route. Those junk-types hit hard.

033.name: Grub
t: Grub: Mind the parts. Half of these are holding the other half together.
Grub: Come back when you've seen a bit more of Ferrox. I might have work for you.
Tower engineer: Hank's apprentices train on this floor. The Keeper waits upstairs.

062.name: Dr. Vashti
t: Dr. Vashti: The signal is clearer here. Neonis hears everything in the system.
Dr. Vashti: Keep going, Linker. Every Shard brings us closer to the truth.

156.name: Returning echo 3
t: Ystran echo: Coral is growing in the Drowned Seas. Aquelion says the dreams are happier.

154.name: Returning echo 2
t: Ystran echo: The floating islands are putting down roots again. Terravox hums when it walks.

098.name: Strand
t: Strand: (quietly) Keep walking. Pell's on the radio, and he notices everything.
Strand: Helix is digging under the Fossil Dig, toward the old Ystran bones. You didn't see me, and I didn't see you.

098.name: Pell
t: Pell: Hello again, Rook. This dig site is Helix business.
Pell: Helix doesn't lose things. We just collect them later.

136.name: Tamsin
t: Tamsin: The crater's three levels deep, and the light gets stranger the further down you go.
Tamsin: Thirty years I've looked for the world on my question-mark patch. Maybe it's down there.

151.name: Dr. Vashti
t: Dr. Vashti: I've got the road, Linker. It's holding. Go and bring her home.
Dr. Vashti: Kessler's side of the Vortex is safe with me.

151.name: Kit
t: Kit: The lens is Teo's crystal map, ground down layer by layer. Took us three weeks!
Kit: If this works, we're walking to another world. No pressure.

158.name: Saga
t: Saga: This was the Choir chamber, where every Ystran sang together. It is an instrument, not a building.
Saga: Gather the echoes. They will come if you call them with the old song.

158.name: Kit
t: Kit: Saga's right. This isn't a building, it's an instrument! A big, broken, beautiful instrument.
Kit: Give me some time. I can fix this.

158.name: Returning echo 4
t: Ystran echo: The Choir chamber sings on its own now. Every note is one of her children.

159.name: Tamsin
t: Tamsin: I'm staying on Ystra. There's a whole map room of places nobody has found yet.
Tamsin: A capture isn't taking. It's asking. Same goes for a world, I think.

160.name: Kit
t: Kit: My {kit3} can heal the blight, slowly, tree by tree. We'll stay and do this part.
Kit: Go on. We've got this. Nobody gets left, remember?

160.name: Returning echo 5
t: Ystran echo: The blight is gone. The little shadows sleep in the new leaves.

166.name: Sola
t: Sola: I made a cactus-berry pie for your mom. It's... a little burned. A lot burned.
Sola: It's weird having a normal day. Good weird.

166.name: Moving box
t: The house is empty. A sign on the door says: Reserved for the Reyes family.

166.name: Teo
t: Teo: I never saw a living Seedmother. Just the empty crater where she stood, and the Heartroot, a little dimmer every year.
Teo: Lumivex grew up near its light. It keeps watch on the roof now. It doesn't trust doors yet. Neither do I.

153.name: Returning echo 1
t: Ystran echo: I remember this place green. Look, the first moss is back on the Arrival Fragment!

163.name: Returning echo 6
t: Ystran echo: Every child came home and stayed itself. That is the whole legend. Thank you, Unifier.

171.name: Fisher
t: Fisher: Mind the nets! I just mended them.
Fisher: On calm nights you can hear Gloopa singing under the piers.

172.name: Rift Scout
t: Rift Scout: Don't touch the crystals. They hum back at you.
Rift Scout: Every night the Rift glows a little brighter. I write it all down.

173.name: Bog Keeper
t: Bog Keeper: Welcome, welcome! Shoes off, the moss is drying.
Bog Keeper: The mushroom lamps glow brighter when a happy Alienmon is near.

174.name: Miner
t: Miner: Long shift in the Deep Mines. Come in, it's cooler in here.
Miner: If your helmet lamp flickers, turn back. That's the rule.

175.name: Sky Weaver
t: Sky Weaver: The clouds drift right past my window. I never get tired of it.
Sky Weaver: Play the harp if you like. The wind shrines answer it, they say.

176.name: Night DJ
t: Night DJ: Oh, a visitor! Welcome to my studio. Well, my living room.
Night DJ: DJ Static lives three towers over. I've heard every set.

177.name: Dig Assistant
t: Dig Assistant: Careful with the scrolls, they're older than the city.
Dig Assistant: Those glyphs on the wall? Even Dr. Vashti hasn't read them all.

178.name: Grandma Frost
t: Grandma Frost: Come warm up by the fire, dear.
Grandma Frost: Ingrid used to sit right there when she was little.

179.name: Airship Captain
t: Captain: Welcome aboard! She's docked for repairs, but the view's still free.
Captain: On a clear day you can see every island in the Halo chain from the helm.

180.name: Prize Clerk
t: Prize Clerk: Welcome to the Neonis Arcade! The machines are being rewired for the big tournament.
Prize Clerk: Come back later and you might win one of those plush Alienmon on the shelf.

181.name: Field Scientist
t: Field Scientist: Ystra was green once. Every sample we take says so.
Field Scientist: The crater readings change whenever a Linker walks by. Strange, isn't it?

182.name: Dock Attendant
t: Dock Attendant: Welcome to the Cloud Dock. Airships leave when the winds allow.
Dock Attendant: Mind the windows, the sky islands drift closer than they look.

183.name: Dig Chief
t: Dig Chief: Every glyph on that board came out of the ground this week.
Dig Chief: Whoever built these ruins knew the stars far better than we do.

184.name: Greeter
t: Greeter: Welcome to Sporeholm! Please don't step on the glowing moss. It bruises.
Greeter: The bog is safest on the lit paths. The mushroom lamps show the way.

185.name: Mushroom Keeper
t: Mushroom Keeper: Oh! A guest inside my mushroom. Mind the jars, they're full of spores.
Mushroom Keeper: This mushroom was growing before my grandmother was born. It's still growing now.

186.name: Lamplighter
t: Lamplighter: Come in, come in. On Umbra we keep every lamp lit, all night long.
Lamplighter: The Devourer follows the light, they say. So we never let it go out.

187.name: Canyon Guide
t: Canyon Guide: Shoes off, the rug's my grandma's. Oven's always warm if you're hungry.
Canyon Guide: When the drift grass crackles at night, the Starfall Crater is glowing.

188.name: Scrap Welder
t: Scrap Welder: Every bolt in this cabin came off a crashed freighter. Hank says it's the sturdiest house on Ferrox.
Scrap Welder: Mind the stove. It runs on old reactor cores.

189.name: Crystal Keeper
t: Crystal Keeper: These crystals grew from the old world-tree's sap. They still hum when an Alienmon walks by.
Crystal Keeper: Ystra was green once. Listen closely and you can hear it remembering.

190.name: Moss Tender
t: Moss Tender: The lamps are glowcaps. Pick one and it sulks for a week.
Moss Tender: Sit, sit. The tea is mostly spores, but the good kind.

191.name: Old Netmender
t: Old Netmender: You can see the whole bay from that window. Captain Marsh's boat comes in at dawn.
Old Netmender: If you hear singing under the pier, that's just the Gloopa. Probably.

192.name: Late-Night Coder
t: Late-Night Coder: Every screen in this place is tuned to DJ Static's channel. Rent includes the bass.
Late-Night Coder: The crystal on the table charges my phone. Don't tell the landlord.

193.name: Ice Fisher
t: Ice Fisher: Fire's always lit. The blue flame burns colder than you'd think, but it keeps the frost off.
Ice Fisher: Ingrid digs fossils all winter. I just dig holes and wait for fish.
Scavenger: The Scrap Route is all junk piles and loose rails. Alienmon love hiding in the scrap.
Hauler: My cart threw a wheel. Again. Third time this week.
Hiker: Tall rust-grass is where the wild ones hide. Walk around it if your team is tired.
Drifter: The crane yard's next. Watch for falling crates.
Crane operator: Three junkers keep jamming my cranes. Hank wants them taught a lesson.
Yard guard: No Helix allowed in this yard. Not after what they pulled last month.
Junk dealer: One Linker's trash is another Linker's treasure. Mostly it's just trash.
Shopper: I came for a bolt and left with a jetpack. It doesn't work, but still.
Ore trader: Ferrox ore powers half the ships in the system. Helix wants all of it.
Fortune teller: I see... a tower. And a man with a very large wrench.
Furnace worker: The heat up here peels paint off ships. Keep your Alienmon hydrated.
Guard: Ferrox Tower is just ahead. Hank Briggs is the Keeper. Good luck, kid.
